title: Async submissions
objective: Prevent duplicate side effects and reuse one idempotency key for retries of the same logical request.
predict: Two clicks and a response-loss retry must produce one logical task, while a later new task gets a new key.
expectedBehavior: Simulate an accepted 201 with a lost response. Retry must preserve both body and key. Double-click while pending and verify no second fetch starts.
commonFailure: The starter generates a new idempotency key for every retry and has no in-flight lock.
securityBoundary: An in-memory idempotency key protects only one process lifetime. Real billing/financial mutations require durable server-side deduplication.
